obligations.title: Exclusive declaration ownership
obligations.conformanceMessage: Every observed member has exactly one declaring classifier.
obligations.violationMessage: At least one observed member has zero or multiple declaring classifiers.

obligations.title: Acyclic generalization
obligations.conformanceMessage: No inheritance cycle exists in the exact observed graph.
obligations.violationMessage: An inheritance cycle exists in the exact observed graph.

obligations.title: Inherited view derivation
obligations.conformanceMessage: The frontend-observed inherited view equals the Alloy-derived view.
obligations.violationMessage: At least one frontend-observed inherited membership differs from the Alloy-derived view.

obligations.title: Local and inherited separation
obligations.conformanceMessage: Local and frontend-observed inherited memberships are atom-disjoint.
obligations.violationMessage: At least one member atom is both local and inherited in the same classifier.

obligations.title: Local namespace uniqueness
obligations.conformanceMessage: Local method keys and attribute names are unique within each classifier.
obligations.violationMessage: At least one classifier contains a duplicate method key or attribute name.
